platforms.notes: APK installs directly on phones. Google Play needs the .aab (set ANDROID_AAB=1; GitHub Actions does).
platforms.stores: Google Play (.aab), Amazon Appstore, Samsung Galaxy Store (.apk)

platforms.notes: Xcode project (built on Linux). Finish on a Mac or a cloud Mac: open CanopyCrossing.xcodeproj, set your Team, Product > Archive, upload to App Store Connect.
One file, the game data is inside the .exe. Not code-signed yet (Windows SmartScreen will warn until it is).
platforms.stores: Steam, GOG, itch.io, Epic, Microsoft Store

platforms.notes: Universal (Apple silicon + Intel) .app in a zip. Not signed or notarized: macOS will refuse to open it normally until it is (needs an Apple Developer account).
platforms.stores: Steam, GOG, itch.io, Epic (after signing + notarizing)

platforms.notes: One file, the game data is inside. Runs on 64-bit Linux with OpenGL 3.3 (and Steam Deck).
Open canopy-crossing.html through a web server (the testers' link serves it). Same files as the live beta link.
platforms.stores: Beta testers' link, itch.io (playable in browser)

note: Each platform has its own folder in apps/CANOPY-CROSSING/BUILDS/. The game files are rebuilt from the source (tools/build_all.sh, or the GitHub Actions workflow 'Canopy Crossing release builds', which also makes Android); they're too big to keep in git.
